fixture_format: DjangoFixtureRecorder schema_version 1; each record includes request, response, database before/after/changed_tables, and captured durable Celery effects.

differential_replay.effects: Durable RabbitMQ effects are covered by source fixture replay with workers stopped; the production-proxy differential compares HTTP status, headers and body only.

scope_decisions: The contract covers exactly the 13 public feedback, intake, vote and workspace board directory operations in the selected endpoint inventory.
Ordinary OPTIONS follows each source route’s session requirement; CORS preflight is captured separately.
Intake and inbox list search/status inputs are recorded with discriminating duplicate/mixed-status rows; the source returns the unfiltered projection.

Vote JSON parse errors and non-object roots are explicit corrections: reject with 400 before vote/member writes; unsupported media keeps 415 and accepted object vote coercions/response scalars remain unchanged.
Intake PATCH requires an object-valued nested issue after board, intake row, creator and live issue scope checks; invalid shapes return 400 without effects.
Creator and date grouping uses the filtered issue queryset; detail assignee IDs are scoped to active membership in the issue project.
Vote serializer coercion preserves valid submitted scalar response values; POST schema is permissive while GET vote values remain integer.

Public intake CREATE validates null/non-object root bodies and nested issue shapes before effects; PATCH checks creator before root shape, then resolves the scoped live issue before validating nested issue shape.

autocommit_partial_write_case.reason: The previous recorder wrapped the request and snapshot in transaction.atomic(); that failure path marked the transaction for rollback and hid the committed public-member insert. The external target request uses normal autocommit. The source case now seeds committed rows, executes the request in autocommit, and snapshots its real partial writes.
